tasks.title: Core Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Initialize the Python package structure. Create `registry.py` to define DatasetIDs from `sg_opendata_collections.py` and `logger.py` for D1-backed logging.

tasks.title: AI & DB Models
tasks.description: Implement `ai_engine.py` with Cloudflare AI Gateway routing. Create `db_models.py` using Pydantic to mirror the `schema.ts` Drizzle definitions.

tasks.title: The Data Refinery (Spatial Logic)
tasks.description: Build `processor.py`. Implement 'Phase A' (Normalization) and 'Phase B' (Spatial Analysis). Must use `shapely` for centroids and `scipy.spatial.cKDTree` for calculating `nearestMrtDistance`.

tasks.title: FastAPI Dashboard
tasks.description: Create `main.py` serving a Jinja2 frontend. Implement the 'Natural Language to SQL' endpoint using `ai_engine.py`.

tasks.title: Dependency Management
tasks.description: Generate `requirements.txt` containing all scientific and web dependencies.
